enrichments.summary: Multiple brands of organic baby carrots are being recalled due to potential contamination with E. coli O121:H19.
Cal-Organic and Marketside brand Organic Baby Carrots and Organic Baby Peeled Carrots are being recalled due to potential contamination with E. coli O121:H19.
Multiple brands of organic whole carrots, including 365, Bunny Luv, Cal-Organic, and others, are being recalled due to potential contamination with E. coli O121:H19.
Cal-Organic is recalling Organic Whole Carrots and Organic Clip Carrots due to potential contamination with E. coli O121:H19.
Grimmway Farms has initiated a recall for its Organic Baby Carrots due to potential contamination with E. coli O121:H19.
